page_title: WER 3-1 FRE | Werder Bremen v Freiburg 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Robert Hartmann has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+5' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+3' 3 - 1 Goal! The ball breaks to Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 3:1.
90+1' The substitution has been made. Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) has replaced Felix Agu.
90+1' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
89' Referee Robert Hartmann has finally had enough of Christian Streich and brandishes a yellow card at him!
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:5.
86' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florent Muslija (Freiburg) replacing Vincenzo Grifo.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
86' That will be all from Justin Njinmah who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen).
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jens Stage walks off the pitch to be replaced by Christian Gross (Werder Bremen).
80' Christian Streich has decided to make a change. Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) replaces Merlin Rohl.
80' Some great controlled play and passing from Freiburg. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
76' The current number of corner kicks is 3:2.
72' The substitution is prepared. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Romano Schmid.
72' Substitution. Marvin Ducksch walks off the pitch and Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) comes on as a substitute.
71' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Lukas Kubler is replaced by Attila Szalai (Freiburg).
71' The game has come to an end for Jordy Makengo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
70' Some patient build-up play from Freiburg as they look to unlock the defence.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.
67' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
64' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
58' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' 2 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
50' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
48' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:4.
45+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
44' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
42' One of the players from Freiburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
39' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
38' Werder Bremen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
36' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
32' The ball possession is 36:64.
28' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Michael Zetterer no chance!
28' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
27' Werder Bremen concede a free kick following a bad challenge. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Freiburg.
25' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
24' Werder Bremen string together a series of short passes.
22' The resulting free kick from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
20' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
16' 42:58 – the ratio of ball possession.
11' The Freiburg players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Noah Atubolu into the bottom left corner.
9' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
9' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Werder Bremen!

8' Play continues despite the shouts by some Werder Bremen players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Robert Hartmann interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
4' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Robert Hartmann will supervise the game today.
